title: KG-Neighbor: Knowledge-Guided Neighborhood Construction for Embedding Visualization
abstract: arXiv:2611.07246v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: In embedding visualizations, nearby instances are interpreted as semantically related, although neighborhoods derived from input embeddings may not reflect content relationships. Neighborhood-based dimensionality reduction (DR) methods can propagate this limitation by optimizing layouts from embedding-based neighborhood graphs. We propose Knowledge-Guided Neighborhood Graph Construction (KGN), which represents relational knowledge derived from each instance as a set of knowledge graph (KG) triples. It uses the degree of triple sharing as pairwise semantic evidence to adjust embedding distances and reconstruct the top-k neighborhood graph; neither KG extraction nor neighborhood construction uses class labels. We also introduce IDProfile (IDP), which interprets residual mismatches by independently assessing whether the source content supports the assigned class label and the neighborhood-majority class. translated_title: KG-Neighbor：面向嵌入可视化的知识引导邻域构建
translated_abstract: 在嵌入可视化中，相邻的实例通常被解读为语义相关，然而由输入嵌入导出的邻域关系可能并不反映内容层面的真实关系。基于邻域的降维（DR）方法通过优化基于嵌入的邻域图来生成布局，可能会延续这一局限性。我们提出了知识引导邻域图构建方法（KGN），它将从每个实例中提取的关系知识表示为一组知识图谱（KG）三元组，并利用三元组的共享程度作为成对语义证据来调整嵌入距离并重建 top-k 邻域图；无论是 KG 抽取还是邻域构建均不使用类别标签。我们还提出了 IDProfile（IDP），通过独立评估源内容是否支持所分配的类别标签以及邻域多数类，来解释残余的不匹配情况。在八个文本和图像数据集上……
tldr: 本文提出知识引导邻域图构建方法KGN，利用从实例中抽取的知识图谱三元组的共享程度作为语义证据来调整嵌入距离并重建top-k邻域图，从而在不使用类别标签的情况下提升嵌入可视化中邻域关系的可靠性，并配套提出IDProfile工具来解释类别标签与邻域多数类之间的残余不匹配。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes KGN, which uses the degree of sharing among knowledge-graph triples extracted from each instance as pairwise semantic evidence to adjust embedding distances and reconstruct the top-k neighborhood graph without using class labels, thereby improving neighborhood reliability in embedding visualization, and introduces IDProfile to interpret residual mismatches between assigned labels and neighborhood-majority classes.
